pr_body:
Fixes the contract violation the contract-test agent raised in #38: `POST /api/healthz` returned 200 instead of 405. Adds the method guard (matching `handleTodos`), documents 405 in `openapi.yaml`, and adds handler-level tests.

Implemented by hand because the @talos code agent hung on this one (Pi stalled, run cancelled after 30+ min) — human fallback. All 9 todo-api tests pass locally.
commit_messages:
fix(todo-api): return 405 for non-GET /api/healthz

Contract-test agent caught this (issue #38): handleHealthz returned 200 for
any method while every sibling route guards with 405. Add the method guard
matching the existing handleTodos pattern, document the 405 in openapi.yaml,
and add a handler-level test (new test/handler.test.js) covering both the
200 and 405 paths.

Implemented directly: the @talos code agent hung on this issue (Pi stalled,
run 27295653691 cancelled after 30+ min) — human fallback per the same
bounded-retry policy. Closes #38.
